question: What sum of money (in ₹) will amount to ₹2,280 in 5 years at 5% per annum simple interest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the Principal be 100%.

Total Simple Interest for 5 years = 5% × 5 = 25% of Principal.

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest = 100% + 25% = 125%.

Given that 125% of the Principal is equal to ₹2,280.

Principal (100%) = (2280 ÷ 125) × 100 = 2280 × (4 ÷ 5) = ₹1,824.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,824.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹2,280

Time (T) = 5 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 5% per annum

**Formula Used:**

A = P + SI = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100]

 
• 
 
 
 Start (T = 0)
 End (T = 5 years)
 P = ? (100%)
 A = ₹2280
 

 Rate = 5% per annum
 
 Total SI = 5% × 5 = 25%
 Amount = 125% of P

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2280 = P × [1 + (5 × 5) ÷ 100]

⇒ 2280 = P × [1 + 25 ÷ 100]

⇒ 2280 = P × [1 + 1 ÷ 4]

⇒ 2280 = P × (5 ÷ 4)

⇒ P = 2280 × (4 ÷ 5)

⇒ P = 456 × 4

⇒ P = 1824

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,824.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

Simple Interest is calculated only on the initial principal amount. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Amount in SI

The total amount paid or received at the end of the time period is the sum of the principal and simple interest: A = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Compound Interest vs Simple Interest

While SI grows linearly as interest is fixed, Compound Interest grows exponentially as interest is earned on accumulated interest from previous periods.
